name: Chatvox
author: WP Problem Solvers

sections.description:
Chatvox helps teams turn website traffic into conversations with branded AI chat agents. The Chatvox WordPress plugin makes it easy to add your Chatvox web widget to a WordPress site without editing theme files.

Create and manage your AI agent at chatvox.co, then paste your Agent ID into WordPress to display the Chatvox widget on your site.

With Chatvox, teams can train AI agents on website pages, documentation, uploaded files, sitemaps, raw text, and Q&A content, then deploy those agents as branded chat experiences. Chatvox also supports public chat links, web widget customization, conversation monitoring, lead capture, domain allowlists, Slack and Salesforce workflows, and custom API actions from the Chatvox platform.

This plugin focuses on WordPress installation only. Agent training, AI models, automations, conversations, leads, and integrations are managed in your Chatvox account.

Plugin highlights:

  • Add a Chatvox AI chatbot to WordPress from Settings > Chatvox.
  • Install the Chatvox web widget without editing your theme files.
  • Store one lightweight Agent ID option in WordPress.
  • Show the widget only when an Agent ID is configured.
  • Keep widget content, branding, automations, and training managed in Chatvox.

External Services

This plugin relies on the third-party/external Chatvox service to load the customer support chat widget on the frontend of your website.

  • Service Name: Chatvox (https://chatvox.co)
  • Script Location: https://my.chatvox.co/embed.js
  • Purpose: Renders the interactive chat widget allowing visitors to communicate with your AI agent.
  • Data Transmission: When the chat widget loads or is interacted with on the frontend, standard visitor browser metadata (such as IP address and user-agent), chat message content, and any information a visitor submits through configured chat workflows may be sent to Chatvox’s servers to process and deliver responses.
  • Terms of Service: https://chatvox.co/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://chatvox.co/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/chatvox, or install Chatvox from the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings > Chatvox.
  4. Enter your Chatvox Agent ID and save changes.
  5. Visit your site to confirm the Chatvox widget appears.
sections.faq:
What is Chatvox?

Chatvox is an AI agent platform for teams. It helps you train agents on your website, docs, files, and other knowledge sources, then deploy those agents as branded chat experiences.

Where do I find my Agent ID?

Open your Chatvox account at chatvox.co, go to your agent deployment settings, and copy the Agent ID used in the web widget install script.

Do I need a Chatvox account?

Yes. This plugin loads an existing Chatvox agent on your WordPress site. You create, train, customize, and manage the agent in Chatvox.

What can I train my Chatvox agent on?

Chatvox supports knowledge sources such as website pages, uploaded files, individual URLs, sitemaps, raw text snippets, Q&A pairs, and website crawls. Training is handled in Chatvox, not inside WordPress.

How do I show the Chatvox widget on my site?

Enter your Chatvox Agent ID in Settings > Chatvox and save. The widget will appear on your site using the configuration from your Chatvox account.

Does this edit my theme files?

No. The plugin uses WordPress script loading hooks and does not modify your theme files.

Can I disable the widget temporarily?

Yes. Clear the Agent ID and save the settings.

Can I customize the widget colors, position, branding, or allowed domains?

Yes. Widget customization and domain allowlist settings are managed in your Chatvox account.

Can Chatvox capture leads?

Chatvox supports lead capture workflows from the Chatvox platform. If enabled for your agent, visitor-submitted lead details are processed by Chatvox according to your Chatvox configuration.

Does this plugin add live chat or AI training features inside WordPress?

No. The plugin installs the Chatvox web widget on WordPress. Chat management, AI training, automations, integrations, and usage settings live in Chatvox.
